action.objective: Verify d2d3, the top exact broad-search suggestion, at full depth with mate safety before committing.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 3/4 suggested d2d3 with the only exact score (59). It reinforces e4/d4 control and opens the c1 bishop path while preparing castling. d2d4/e2e4 were upper bounds at lower confidence, and f3d4 was an upper bound. d2d3 is the reserved verification candidate, so spending the 2000-node verification allowance on it is appropriate to confirm safety and score at full depth.
